claim.en: Forró chairs the Hungarian-minority party Aliancia – Szövetség; he joined SMK in 2004 and was its last chair in 2020–2021.
claim.sk: Forró je predsedom strany maďarskej menšiny Aliancia – Szövetség; do SMK vstúpil v roku 2004 a v rokoch 2020 – 2021 bol jej posledným predsedom.

findings.identity: profile of presidential candidate Krisztián Forró, 48, Veľká Mača (Galanta district)
findings.quote: Krisztián Forró, chair of the non-parliamentary Hungarian minority political party Aliancia - Szövetség, is the only ethnic Hungarian candidate in the 2024 presidential election. Forró joined the Party of the Hungarian Coalition (SMK) in 2004, and served as its last chair in 2020-2021.
findings.title: Slovakia: Who are the 2024 presidential election candidates?
